# Flowchart syntax

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-grammar from packages/diagram-flowchart/grammar/flowchart.ebnf. Do not edit: run `pnpm gen:grammar`. -->

Flowchart syntax (R-PARSE-9, D54): the normative grammar of `flowchart` / `graph` diagrams.

The hand-written parser in `src/parser/` implements it; `tools/gen-grammar` builds a reference
parser, a sentence generator, highlighters and the syntax reference page from it. mermaid@12
decides what is valid, this file is fixed to match, and the parser must match this file
(DESIGN §4.4).

**Lexer input.** The lexer reads the diagram body as mermaid@12 handed it to its lexer: front
matter and `%%{…}%%` directives removed; CRLF read as LF; `="x"` inside an HTML tag read as
`='x'`; `%%` comment lines removed and leading blanks trimmed; on a line with
`style…:…#…;` (or `classDef…`) the last `;` dropped; `#name;` / `#123;` entities kept
as opaque label text that no rule outside a label matches; `}` and blanks before a line break
read as `}` and the line break; and a line break appended.

## Grammar

EBNF: `[ x ]` is optional, `{ x }` repeats zero or more times, `x+` one or more times, `|` separates alternatives. Upper-case names and `subgraph`, `end`, `acc_…`, `direction_…` are tokens (see below). A rule marked `@Type` builds an AST node of that type.

A diagram is a header line, then statements separated by line breaks or `;`.

```ebnf
flowchart = { SPACE | NEWLINE } header document ;
```

`flowchart LR`, `graph TD`, … The direction is optional (default `TB`).

```ebnf
header = headerNoDir
       | headerDir firstSeparator ;
```

```ebnf
headerNoDir @Header = GRAPH NODIR ;
```

```ebnf
headerDir @Header = GRAPH DIR ;
```

```ebnf
firstSeparator = SEMI
               | NEWLINE
               | SPACE+ NEWLINE ;
```

```ebnf
document = { statement | SEMI | NEWLINE | SPACE | EOF } ;
```

```ebnf
separator = NEWLINE
          | SEMI
          | EOF ;
```

```ebnf
statement = Chain separator
          | Style separator
          | LinkStyle separator
          | ClassDef separator
          | Class separator
          | Click separator
          | Subgraph
          | Direction
          | AccTitle
          | AccDescr ;
```

Nodes joined by links: `A --> B & C -.-> D`. Blanks after shape data must lead to `&`.

```ebnf
Chain @Chain = nodeGroup { Link nodeGroup } ;
```

```ebnf
nodeGroup = { node SPACE+ AMP SPACE+ } ( plainNode [ SPACE+ ] | dataNode ) ;
```

```ebnf
node = plainNode
     | dataNode ;
```

One node mention: an id, an optional shape with its label, a class, shape data.

```ebnf
plainNode @Node = vertex [ STYLE_SEPARATOR idString ] ;
```

```ebnf
dataNode @Node = vertex [ STYLE_SEPARATOR idString ] shapeData ;
```

```ebnf
vertex = idString [ shape ] ;
```

```ebnf
shapeData = SHAPE_DATA+ ;
```

```ebnf
shape = SQS text SQE
      | DOUBLECIRCLESTART text DOUBLECIRCLEEND
      | PS PS text PE PE
      | ELLIPSE_START text ELLIPSE_END
      | STADIUMSTART text STADIUMEND
      | SUBROUTINESTART text SUBROUTINEEND
      | VERTEX_WITH_PROPS_START NODE_STRING COLON NODE_STRING PIPE text SQE
      | CYLINDERSTART text CYLINDEREND
      | PS text PE
      | DIAMOND_START text DIAMOND_STOP
      | DIAMOND_START DIAMOND_START text DIAMOND_STOP DIAMOND_STOP
      | TAGEND text SQE
      | TRAPSTART text ( TRAPEND | INVTRAPEND )
      | INVTRAPSTART text ( INVTRAPEND | TRAPEND ) ;
```

A link, with an optional id, and text either between pipes or inside the arrow.

```ebnf
Link @Link = [ LINK_ID ] LINK [ PIPE text PIPE [ SPACE ] ]
           | [ LINK_ID ] START_LINK edgeText LINK ;
```

Label text: a string or text tokens, then more text tokens.

```ebnf
text = ( textToken | STR | MD_STR ) { textToken } ;
```

```ebnf
textToken = TEXT
          | TAGSTART
          | TAGEND
          | UNICODE_TEXT ;
```

```ebnf
edgeText = ( edgeTextToken | STR | MD_STR ) { edgeTextToken } ;
```

```ebnf
edgeTextToken = EDGE_TEXT
              | UNICODE_TEXT ;
```

```ebnf
textNoTags = ( textNoTagsToken | STR | MD_STR ) { textNoTagsToken } ;
```

```ebnf
textNoTagsToken = NUM
                | NODE_STRING
                | SPACE
                | MINUS
                | AMP
                | UNICODE_TEXT
                | COLON
                | MULT
                | BRKT
                | keyword
                | START_LINK ;
```

```ebnf
keyword = STYLE
        | LINKSTYLE
        | CLASSDEF
        | CLASS
        | CLICK
        | GRAPH
        | DIR
        | subgraph
        | end
        | DOWN
        | UP ;
```

```ebnf
idString = idStringToken+ ;
```

```ebnf
idStringToken = NUM
              | NODE_STRING
              | DOWN
              | MINUS
              | DEFAULT
              | COMMA
              | COLON
              | AMP
              | BRKT
              | MULT
              | UNICODE_TEXT ;
```

```ebnf
alphaNum = alphaNumToken+ ;
```

```ebnf
alphaNumToken = NUM
              | UNICODE_TEXT
              | NODE_STRING
              | DIR
              | DOWN
              | MINUS
              | COMMA
              | COLON
              | AMP
              | BRKT
              | MULT ;
```

`subgraph id`, `subgraph id [title]` or `subgraph`, then statements, then `end`.

```ebnf
Subgraph @Subgraph = subgraph SPACE textNoTags [ SQS text SQE ] separator document end
                   | subgraph separator document end ;
```

`style id fill:#f9f,stroke:#333`: styles one node or subgraph.

```ebnf
Style @Style = STYLE SPACE idString SPACE styles ;
```

`classDef name fill:#f9f,color:#000`: defines a class of styles; `classDef default …`
styles every node without a class.

```ebnf
ClassDef @ClassDef = CLASSDEF SPACE idString SPACE styles ;
```

`class A,B name`: gives nodes a class (as `A:::name` does).

```ebnf
Class @Class = CLASS SPACE idString SPACE idString ;
```

`linkStyle 0,2 stroke:#f00`: styles links by their position in the source, from 0;
`linkStyle default …` styles every link; `interpolate curve` sets their curve.

```ebnf
LinkStyle @LinkStyle = LINKSTYLE SPACE ( DEFAULT | numList ) SPACE ( styles | INTERPOLATE SPACE alphaNum [ SPACE styles ] ) ;
```

```ebnf
numList = NUM { COMMA NUM } ;
```

```ebnf
styles = style { COMMA style } ;
```

```ebnf
style = ( NUM | NODE_STRING | COLON | SPACE | BRKT | STYLE )+ ;
```

`click id callback`, `click id call fn(args)`, `click id "url"`, `click id href "url"`,
each with an optional tooltip; urls take an optional target.

```ebnf
Click @Click = CLICK ( CALLBACKNAME [ CALLBACKARGS ] [ SPACE STR ] | alphaNum [ SPACE STR ] | [ HREF ] STR [ SPACE STR ] [ SPACE LINK_TARGET ] ) ;
```

`direction LR` inside a subgraph: the direction of its layout.

```ebnf
Direction @Direction = direction_tb
                     | direction_bt
                     | direction_rl
                     | direction_lr
                     | direction_td ;
```

`accTitle: …`: the accessible title of the diagram.

```ebnf
AccTitle @AccTitle = acc_title acc_title_value ;
```

`accDescr: …` or `accDescr { … }`: the accessible description of the diagram.

```ebnf
AccDescr @AccDescr = acc_descr acc_descr_value
                   | acc_descr_multiline_value ;
```

## Tokens

The lexer works in modes (`INITIAL` and the ones below). In each mode it tries the rules in this order and takes the first that matches; a rule may push a mode or pop back to the previous one. Rules without a token emit nothing.

Modes: `INITIAL`, `string`, `md_string`, `acc_title`, `acc_descr`, `acc_descr_multiline`, `dir`, `text`, `ellipseText`, `trapText`, `edgeText`, `thickEdgeText`, `dottedEdgeText`, `click`, `callbackname`, `callbackargs`, `shapeData`, `shapeDataStr`.

| Modes | Token | Pattern | Action | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| INITIAL | acc_title | `accTitle\s*:\s*` | push(acc_title) | `accTitle: …` and `accDescr: …` take the rest of the line; `accDescr { … }` runs to `}`. |
| acc_title | acc_title_value | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | acc_descr | `accDescr\s*:\s*` | push(acc_descr) |  |
| acc_descr | acc_descr_value | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | — | `accDescr\s*\{\s*` | push(acc_descr_multiline) |  |
| acc_descr_multiline | — | `\}` | pop |  |
| acc_descr_multiline | acc_descr_multiline_value | `[^}]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | SHAPE_DATA | `@\{` | push(shapeData) empty | Shape data `@{ … }`: YAML in braces; line breaks in a quoted value read as `<br/>`. |
| shapeData | SHAPE_DATA | `"` | push(shapeDataStr) |  |
| shapeDataStr | SHAPE_DATA | `"` | pop |  |
| shapeDataStr | SHAPE_DATA | `[^"]+` | fold |  |
| shapeData | SHAPE_DATA | `[^}^"]+` |  |  |
| shapeData | — | `\}` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | — | `call\s+` | push(callbackname) | `call name(args)` after `click <id>`. |
| callbackname | — | `\(\s*\)` | pop |  |
| callbackname | — | `\(` | pop push(callbackargs) |  |
| callbackname | CALLBACKNAME | `[^(]*` |  |  |
| callbackargs | — | `\)` | pop |  |
| callbackargs | CALLBACKARGS | `[^)]*` |  |  |
| md_string | MD_STR | `[^`"]+` |  | Strings: `"…"` and markdown strings `` "`…`" ``. They open in every mode. |
| md_string | — | ``"` | pop |  |
| * | — | `"`` | push(md_string) |  |
| string | STR | `[^"]+` |  |  |
| string | — | `"` | pop |  |
| * | — | `"` | push(string) |  |
| INITIAL | STYLE | `style\b` |  | Statement keywords. |
| INITIAL | DEFAULT | `default\b` |  | `classDef default …` styles every node without a class; `linkStyle default …` every link. |
| INITIAL | LINKSTYLE | `linkStyle\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | INTERPOLATE | `interpolate\b` |  | `linkStyle … interpolate curve`: the curve the links are drawn with (`basis`, `linear`, …). |
| INITIAL | CLASSDEF | `classDef\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | CLASS | `class\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | HREF | `href\s` |  |  |
| INITIAL | — | `click\s+` | push(click) | `click <id>`: the id is the next run of non-blanks. |
| click | — | `\s` | pop |  |
| click | CLICK | `\S*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | GRAPH | `(?:flowchart-elk\|swimlane-beta\|graph\|flowchart)\b` | push-once(dir) | The header keyword; only the first one opens the direction mode. |
| INITIAL | subgraph | `subgraph\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | end | `end\b\s*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | LINK_TARGET | `(?:_self\|_blank\|_parent\|_top)\b` |  |  |
| dir | NODIR | `(?:\r?\n)*\s*\n` | pop | The header's direction, or a line break for none. |
| dir | DIR | `\s*(?:LR\|RL\|TB\|BT\|TD\|BR)\b\|\s*[<>^]\|\s*v\b` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | direction_tb | `.*direction\s+TB[^\n]*` |  | `direction TB` inside a subgraph: the whole line is one token. |
| INITIAL | direction_bt | `.*direction\s+BT[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | direction_rl | `.*direction\s+RL[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | direction_lr | `.*direction\s+LR[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | direction_td | `.*direction\s+TD[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | LINK_ID | `[^\s"]+@(?=[^{"])` |  | An edge id `e1@` before a link: the run up to its last `@` not followed by `{` or `"`. |
| INITIAL | NUM | `[0-9]+` |  |  |
| INITIAL | BRKT | `#` |  |  |
| INITIAL | STYLE_SEPARATOR | `:::` |  | `A:::name`: gives the node a class, as `class A name` does. |
| INITIAL | COLON | `:` |  |  |
| INITIAL | AMP | `&` |  |  |
| INITIAL | SEMI | `;` |  |  |
| INITIAL | COMMA | `,` |  |  |
| INITIAL | MULT | `\*` |  |  |
| INITIAL, edgeText | LINK | `\s*[xo<]?--+[-xo>]\s*` | pop | A link: `-->`, `---`, `-.->`, `==>`, `~~~`; `>`, `o` or `x` heads (`<`, `o`, `x` at the start too for both ends). `--`, `==` and `-.` followed by text open an edge-text mode, closed by the arrow. |
| INITIAL | START_LINK | `\s*[xo<]?--\s*` | push(edgeText) |  |
| edgeText | EDGE_TEXT | `[^-]\|-(?!-)` |  |  |
| INITIAL, thickEdgeText | LINK | `\s*[xo<]?==+[=xo>]\s*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | START_LINK | `\s*[xo<]?==\s*` | push(thickEdgeText) |  |
| thickEdgeText | EDGE_TEXT | `[^=]` |  |  |
| INITIAL, dottedEdgeText | LINK | `\s*[xo<]?-?\.+-[xo>]?\s*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | START_LINK | `\s*[xo<]?-\.\s*` | push(dottedEdgeText) |  |
| dottedEdgeText | EDGE_TEXT | `[^.]` |  |  |
| * | LINK | `\s*~~~+\s*` |  |  |
| ellipseText | ELLIPSE_END | `[-\/)]\)` | pop | Node shapes: an opener pushes a label mode, the matching closer pops it. |
| ellipseText | TEXT | `[^()[\]{}]\|!\)+` |  |  |
| * | ELLIPSE_START | `\(-` | push(ellipseText) |  |
| text | STADIUMEND | `\]\)` | pop |  |
| * | STADIUMSTART | `\(\[` | push(text) |  |
| text | SUBROUTINEEND | `\]\]` | pop |  |
| * | SUBROUTINESTART | `\[\[` | push(text) |  |
| INITIAL | VERTEX_WITH_PROPS_START | `\[\\|` |  |  |
| INITIAL | TAGEND | `>` | push(text) |  |
| text | CYLINDEREND | `\)\]` | pop |  |
| * | CYLINDERSTART | `\[\(` | push(text) |  |
| text | DOUBLECIRCLEEND | `\)\)\)` | pop |  |
| * | DOUBLECIRCLESTART | `\(\(\(` | push(text) |  |
| trapText | TRAPEND | `[\\(?=\]]\]` | pop |  |
| trapText | INVTRAPEND | `\/\]` | pop |  |
| trapText | TEXT | `\/(?!\])\|\\(?!\])\|[^\\[\](){}\/]+` |  |  |
| * | TRAPSTART | `\[\/` | push(trapText) |  |
| * | INVTRAPSTART | `\[\\` | push(trapText) |  |
| INITIAL | TAGSTART | `<` |  |  |
| INITIAL | UP | `\^` |  |  |
| INITIAL | SEP | `\\\\|` |  |  |
| INITIAL | DOWN | `v\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_STRING | `(?:[A-Za-z0-9!"#$%&'*+.`?\\_\/]\|-(?=[^>\-.]))+` |  | Node ids. `-` joins an id unless an arrow (`>`, `-`, `.`) follows; `=` never does. |
| INITIAL | MINUS | `-` |  |  |
| INITIAL | UNICODE_TEXT | `[\u00AA\u00B5\u00BA\u00C0-\u00D6\u00D8-\u00F6\u00F8-\u02C1\u02C6-\u02D1\u02E0…` |  | Letters outside ASCII (v12's `UNICODE_TEXT` class), one per token. |
| text | PIPE | `\\|` | pop | Plain label brackets, and the text inside them. |
| * | PIPE | `\\|` | push(text) |  |
| text | PE | `\)` | pop |  |
| * | PS | `\(` | push(text) |  |
| text | SQE | `\]` | pop |  |
| * | SQS | `\[` | push(text) |  |
| text | DIAMOND_STOP | `\}` | pop |  |
| * | DIAMOND_START | `\{` | push(text) |  |
| text | TEXT | `[^[\](){}\|"]+` |  |  |
| INITIAL | NEWLINE | `(?:\r?\n)+` |  | Separators. `EOF` is the end of the text in the initial mode. |
| INITIAL | SPACE | `[^\S\n\r]+` |  |  |
| INITIAL | EOF | `$` |  |  |

Removed before lexing (highlighted only):

- COMMENT: `^[^\S\n]*%%(?!\{)[^\n]+`
- DIRECTIVE: `[^\S\n]*%%\{[\s\S]*?\}%%`
